content: Service Name Sd_ Service Group Start Syntax void Sd_ Service Group Start ( Sd_ Service Group Id Type Service Group Id ) Service ID [hex] 0x44 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different Sd Service Group S. Non reentrant for the same Sd Service Group. Parameters (in) Service Group Id Id of Sd Service Group to be started Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Starts a preconfigured Sd Service Group. For example, Offer Service entries will be sent out after the call of Sd_ Service Group Start() for all Server Servives of a Sd Service Group, which are not requested yet. Available via Sd.h
